items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-29
items.q: In this band? Yeah. Alvin Alcorn. Always? Well, until after I stopped. I was in the same room.

ctx.x: He swings with every note that trumpet plays. That's right. It must be Billy, huh? That's Billy.
Well, you have Billy, and then you have Alcorn and Arnie.
